### [Armed-Conflict Violence in Colombia](projects/colombia-violence-eda.html)

An exploratory analysis of recorded conflict-related violence between 2018 and 2024, examining temporal patterns, geographic distributions, and violence categories.

**Methods:** Python · Exploratory Data Analysis · Data Visualization

[Explore Project →](projects/colombia-violence-eda.html)

[GEOSPATIAL & CLIMATE ANALYSIS]{.project-category}

### [Urban Heat Islands in Santiago](projects/santiago-urban-heat.html)

Exploring the spatial distribution of land surface temperatures and demographic vulnerability in Greater Santiago through satellite imagery and spatial statistics.

**Methods:** Python · GIS · Moran's I · LISA

[Explore Project →](projects/santiago-urban-heat.html)
